* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Catalina.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/First Date|First Date]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Bank.png]]Inside Track Betting shop, Montgomery, Red County
|}

Upon entering the red marker, Catalina hands you 10 satchel charges. Upon entering the shop, you must place and detonate a satchel charge on the door leading to the safe, and then another on the door of the safe inside.

After looting the safe, you emerge from the shop with a 4-star wanted level, and you'll have to head to the indicated Pay N Spray in Dillimore. Now just drive Catalina back to her hideout to complete the mission.

== Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $2,000
* '''Item''': Satchel Charges
